<thought>To locate the Wolff‑Kishner reduction template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a carbonyl (C=O) bond. The functional‑group name for the carbonyl is “ketones”, and the bond type for a carbonyl is a double bond between a carbon (atomic number 6) and an oxygen (atomic number 8), i.e., “6-8”. Using these criteria should return templates that convert a ketone into an alkane, which is the Wolff‑Kishner transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"]
}</action_input>
